newsitem.title: INDIA: Norway keen to establish business ties with India.
newsitem.headline: Norway keen to establish business ties with India.

text.p: Norway is keen to establish commercial ties with India in areas where it has a competitive edge and which are crucial for India to speed up economic reforms, Norway's ambassador to India said on Tuesday.
Arne Walther said Norway had a competitive edge in sectors such as oil and natural gas, hydro-electricity, environmental technology, fisheries and shipping.

"These are the sectors where Norway has a state-of-the-art technology and a competitive edge internationally," Walther told a meeting of the Confederation of Indian Industry and the Confederation of Norwegian Business and Industry.
"These sectors are crucial also to the developments in India, especially in the context of your (India's) policies of economic reform."
Walther said the Norwegian government, after a dialogue with Norwegian business interests, had developed a "strategic plan" for increased business co-operation with Asian countries.
"The fundamental concept of this strategic plan is to develop co-operation in the political, economic and cultural fields," Walther said.
He said this would create a framework for more systematic efforts to increase trade, business development and economic co-operation with Asia in the long-term.
